Entry Winter Stores Grain, Winter Stores, and Famine: The long and unpredictable seasons of Westeros make winter storage fundamental to the politics of each territory. Grains must be dried and stored in warehouses, meat must be pickled, fish must be smoked, and firewood, seeds, oats, and salt must all be prepared before the severe winter; therefore, grain storage in the north is regarded as almost sacred. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
